critical_path_summary.staffing_implication: Backend Developer and Platform Architect must be dedicated (not shared) across Phases 1-4; Frontend Developer can be shared with other projects during Phase 1 discovery.

phases.name: Discovery & Design
milestones: API gateway platform selected and approved
Authentication protocol and integration points defined
Architecture and data flow diagrams approved
Success metrics and adoption plan documented

tasks.name: Conduct stakeholder alignment session and document scope sign-off
tasks.definition_of_done: Stakeholder sign-off document signed by all decision-makers; scope boundaries and success criteria agreed.

tasks.name: Evaluate and select API gateway platform (Kong, AWS API Gateway, or custom)
tasks.definition_of_done: Platform selection document with pros/cons analysis; team consensus on chosen platform; procurement initiated if commercial.

tasks.name: Define user personas and success metrics for adoption
tasks.definition_of_done: Persona document with 3-4 internal developer archetypes; adoption KPIs (e.g., % of services routed through gateway by month 3).

tasks.name: Design authentication and authorization architecture (OAuth 2.0/JWT with RBAC)
tasks.definition_of_done: Auth architecture diagram; token flow documentation; RBAC policy model; integration points with existing identity provider identified.

tasks.name: Create API gateway data flow and routing architecture diagrams
tasks.definition_of_done: Architecture diagrams (request flow, service mesh, logging pipeline) approved by tech lead; design review completed.

tasks.name: Document API versioning strategy and routing rules
tasks.definition_of_done: Versioning strategy document (header-based, path-based, or hybrid); routing rule examples for 3+ microservices.

phases.name: Core Development (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 1: Core gateway routing and request/response handling operational
Sprint 2: Authentication and authorization fully integrated
Sprint 3: Rate limiting and load balancing implemented
Internal demo completed; core user flows end-to-end

tasks.name: Set up gateway infrastructure and deployment pipeline (Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud platform)
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway container image built and pushed to registry; CI/CD pipeline for gateway deployments operational; dev and staging environments ready.

tasks.name: Implement core request routing logic and HTTP request/response handling
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway accepts HTTP requests; routes to correct microservice based on path/host; returns response to client; unit tests pass.

tasks.name: Implement OAuth 2.0/JWT token validation and RBAC enforcement
tasks.definition_of_done: Token validation middleware integrated; RBAC policies enforced; unauthorized requests rejected with 401/403; integration tests with mock auth service pass.

tasks.name: Implement rate limiting (token bucket or sliding window algorithm)
tasks.definition_of_done: Rate limiting enforced per client/endpoint; 429 responses returned when limit exceeded; configuration via gateway rules; load tests confirm limits respected.

tasks.name: Implement request/response logging pipeline to centralized logging service
tasks.definition_of_done: All API requests logged with timestamp, client ID, endpoint, status code, response time; logs shipped to centralized service; 90-day retention configured.

tasks.name: Implement load balancing across microservice instances (round-robin or least-connections)
tasks.definition_of_done: Load balancer distributes requests across 2+ microservice instances; health checks detect failed instances; failover tested.

tasks.name: Implement API versioning support (header or path-based routing)
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway routes requests to correct API version; version mismatch returns 400 with clear error; integration tests cover 2+ versions.

tasks.name: Build gateway configuration management UI or API for development team
tasks.definition_of_done: Development team can add/modify routing rules, rate limits, and auth policies via UI or API; changes take effect within 1 minute; audit log of all changes.

tasks.name: Conduct internal demo with core user flows end-to-end
tasks.definition_of_done: Demo script executed; stakeholders confirm core routing, auth, and logging working; feedback documented; no critical blockers identified.

phases.name: Integration & Edge Cases (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 4: All integrations with microservices tested; edge cases handled
Sprint 5: Security review completed; performance benchmarks met
All critical bugs resolved; gateway ready for QA

tasks.name: Integrate gateway with 3+ microservices; test end-to-end routing
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway successfully routes requests to 3+ microservices; response times logged; no dropped requests; integration tests pass.

tasks.name: Implement error handling and retry logic for failed microservice calls
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway retries failed requests (exponential backoff); circuit breaker pattern implemented; timeout handling tested; error responses logged.

tasks.name: Implement request/response transformation and header manipulation
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway can add/remove/modify headers; transform request/response payloads; configuration-driven transformations; unit tests pass.

tasks.name: Conduct security review and implement TLS/SSL, input validation, and injection prevention
tasks.definition_of_done: Security review checklist completed; TLS 1.2+ enforced; input validation on all endpoints; SQL/command injection prevention tested; no critical vulnerabilities.

tasks.name: Implement monitoring, alerting, and health check endpoints
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway exposes /health endpoint; metrics (request count, latency, error rate) exported; alerts configured for high error rates or latency; dashboards created.

tasks.name: Performance testing and optimization (load testing, latency benchmarks)
tasks.definition_of_done: Load test with 1000+ concurrent requests; p99 latency < 2s; no memory leaks; throughput benchmarks documented; optimization recommendations implemented.

tasks.name: Implement graceful shutdown and rolling deployment support
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway drains in-flight requests on shutdown; rolling deployments tested; zero downtime deployments confirmed; runbook documented.

tasks.name: Resolve critical bugs and edge cases identified in integration testing
tasks.definition_of_done: All P0/P1 bugs fixed and verified; edge cases (malformed requests, timeout scenarios) handled; regression tests pass.

phases.name: QA & Testing
milestones: UAT completed with internal development team

tasks.name: Execute comprehensive functional test suite (routing, auth, rate limiting, logging)
tasks.definition_of_done: Test cases for all 7 use cases executed; pass rate ≥ 95%; defects logged and prioritized; regression tests automated.

tasks.name: Conduct UAT with internal development team (3+ representative users)
tasks.definition_of_done: UAT sign-off from 3+ internal developers; feedback documented; critical issues resolved; gateway approved for production.

tasks.name: Perform accessibility audit (WCAG 2.1 AA) on gateway configuration UI
tasks.definition_of_done: Accessibility audit completed; WCAG 2.1 AA compliance verified; keyboard navigation tested; screen reader compatibility confirmed.

tasks.name: Write operational runbooks and troubleshooting guides
tasks.definition_of_done: Runbooks cover deployment, scaling, monitoring, incident response; troubleshooting guide for common issues; team trained on runbooks.

tasks.name: Write API gateway user documentation and integration guide for microservices
tasks.definition_of_done: User guide for configuring gateway rules; integration guide for microservices; API reference documentation; examples for 3+ use cases.

tasks.name: Create adoption plan and communication strategy for internal rollout
tasks.definition_of_done: Adoption plan with timeline for service migration; communication plan (email, wiki, training sessions); success metrics and tracking mechanism.

tasks.name: Identify and document post-launch ownership and support model
tasks.definition_of_done: Post-launch owner named; support escalation path defined; SLA for bug fixes and feature requests documented; handoff meeting completed.

tasks.name: Deploy gateway to production environment with zero-downtime strategy
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway deployed to production; blue-green or canary deployment executed; no service interruption; rollback plan tested.

tasks.name: Execute smoke tests and production validation (routing, auth, logging)
tasks.definition_of_done: Smoke test suite executed in production; all critical paths validated; no errors in production logs; performance metrics within SLA.

tasks.name: Obtain go-live sign-off from stakeholders and product owner
tasks.definition_of_done: Go-live sign-off document signed; stakeholders confirm gateway ready for internal rollout; launch date confirmed.
